7. Use the original energy for every outgoing arc and capFor an active phase z, combine its inherited H(z)=H(z₀) with H(Φ_tz)=H(z). The actual rate is nonnegative, and the already proved same-energy-layer bound gives λ(Φ_tz)≤C(z₀). Since C depends on phase only through H, it also gives C(z)=C(z₀). The displayed arc conclusion keeps its source t<τ guard.H(Φtz)=H(z0),0≤λ(Φtz)≤C(z0),C(z)=C(z0).Corresponding Lean step  have harcs (y xRef : E) (z₀ : E × E) (e : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
      (a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) (ha : record y xRef z₀ e n = Sum.inl a) :
      H y xRef a.2 = H y xRef z₀ ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ≥0, (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (e n) →
        H y xRef (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) a.2) = H y xRef z₀ ∧
        0 ≤ rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) a.2) ∧
        rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) a.2) ≤ C y xRef z₀ :=
